TSMC Reports Sixth Consecutive Record Quarterly Profit Driven by AI Chip Demand

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) is projected to announce its sixth consecutive quarter of record profits, fueled by a significant increase in demand for artificial intelligence (AI) chips. Analysts anticipate a 65% rise in profit, with investors closely watching for updated guidance. The company is also proceeding with global manufacturing expansion plans, despite ongoing concerns about interest rates.
